method: All 15 two-attribute pairs. Full holdings of both attributes (2 each), not initial assets or first reward. Same number of candidates (the known starter replaces one candidate for the four standard pairs); minimum6 cards and one person per attribute, minimum4 attacks, legal20/max2. Choose on separate training seeds, averaged across finance/public and all preparations. Validate unchanged selected deck over intro/finance/public and all preparations, tactical policy only; no prep-specific build, no human/browser test, no optimality guarantee. Rewards occur after each trial and do not carry into the next.
